message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The person is a health administrative law enforcement officer, who failed to transfer cases of illegal medical practice to criminal authorities, instead gave administrative penalties, allowing continued illegal practice, for personal/economic benefit. This is likely "徇私舞弊" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty) which under Chinese criminal law is "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power) or "玩忽职守罪" (negligence of duty). Also "徇私舞弊" is a specific crime: "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). In Chinese criminal law, article 397 (now 397?) "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty) includes: (1) State functionaries who, in performance of duties, accept bribes, etc., or (2) who fail to report crimes that should be reported. Actually article 397: "国家工作人员徇私舞弊，致使国家和人民利益受到重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" Also "玩忽职守罪" is for negligence causing loss. Here they intentionally didn't transfer, for personal economic benefit. That's "徇私舞弊罪". Also could be "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power) but the description matches "徇私舞弊". In examples, they often label as "受贿;滥用职权". Here no bribery, but abuse of power for personal benefit. So answer likely "徇私舞弊". In Chinese, they may list as "徇私舞弊罪". So final answer: [罪名]徇私舞弊<eoa>.
